location.ref: Sahaj Prakāś ('rām tajūṃ pai guru na bisārūṃ …')

paraphrase: I may give up Rām but I will not forget the guru; I do not regard Hari as equal to the guru: Hari gave me birth into the world, the guru cut the round of birth and death; Hari gave me the five thieves, the guru freed me from them.
speaker: Sahajobāī

location.ref: Sahaj Prakāś, on death and detachment

paraphrase: The body is a guest for a few days; the world is a fair that breaks up at evening; do not be proud of youth or wealth — remember the Name before death comes.
speaker: Sahajobāī
